setup.description: Minimal setup shell commands (at most 1-3) executed to prepare a fresh worktree, e.g. ['poetry install'] or ['bun install']. Empty array [] if standard checkout requires no setup.

gates.description: Repository quality gates (compile, typecheck, lint, fast tests) defined by the project. If any gate fails on clean checkout, record it as is — the engine records baseline status.

command.description: Shell command to run for this gate, e.g. 'ruff check .', 'pytest', 'tsc --noEmit'

testRunner.description: Project test runner configuration for automated red/green checking and JUnit XML reporting

command.description: Base test runner shell command, e.g. 'pytest', 'cargo test', 'bun test', 'npm test'

selectorArgs.description: Flag prefix for test selectors. MUST be [] (positional) unless the runner consumes selectors behind a flag. pytest node-ids are positional: ALWAYS []. unittest dotted ids: []. bun/node paths: []. jest/vitest ['-t'] ONLY for bare keyword selectors.

junitArg.description: Flag/argument template to output JUnit XML report, with '{path}' or '{{path}}' placeholder for the file path. E.g. '--junitxml={path}' for pytest, '--reporter=junit --output={path}', or '' if unsupported.

notes.description: Optional notes or operator actions (e.g. advising to exclude the orchestration folder from project linters)
